name: CROW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands in a 2-out-of-3-falls, falls-count-anywhere main event at Scorch Wave 98.

name: CROW International Championship
epitaph: Changed hands at Schools Out For Summer after outside interference struck the wrong man, then survived a ladder-match defense a month later.

name: CROW Light Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Won in a battle royal, stripped during the promotion's mid-1998 reorganization, and reported under a new holder by the promotion's own October ranking sheet.

name: CROW Television Championship
epitaph: Awarded vacant at Schools Out For Summer and changed hands again before the promotion's own next pay-per-view.

name: CROW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held since May 1998 by the Gospel Preachers until a ringside stable's interference cost them the belts at Scorch Wave 98.
